title: ComponentType
description: Definition of a component type (node kind) plus the catalog of actions a user can perform on it. Action catalogs are grounded in Microsoft Learn docs via the `sources` field.

id.description: PascalCase type name, e.g. Report, SemanticModel, Workspace.

extends.description: Optional parent type; child inherits allowedEdges and actions unless overridden.

sources.description: Canonical Microsoft Learn URLs used to derive and verify this type's action catalog.

allowedEdges.description: Edge kinds this component type may participate in (from ontology/edge-types.yaml).

id.description: kebab-case action verb, e.g. view, share, export-to-pdf.

requires.description: Permissions/roles/licences/tenant settings required. Each item is `<facet>:<slug>`.

sideEffects.description: Observable effects, e.g. audit events, label inheritance.
